issue.title: UTable header cells are missing aria-sort, screen readers don't announce sort state
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Screen reader: VoiceOver on macOS 15, Safari

### Description

Sortable `UTable` column headers render as `<th>` with a click handler but no `aria-sort` attribute. VoiceOver never announces whether a column is sorted or in which direction, so keyboard and screen reader users have no way to tell the current sort state.

### Expected behavior

Each sortable header should expose `aria-sort="ascending" | "descending" | "none"` and update it when the sort changes, per the WAI-ARIA table sorting pattern.

### Actual behavior

No `aria-sort` attribute is present in the rendered markup at all.
